drivers: Three independent attribute rules (count progression, shape Latin square, fill Latin square) must all be tracked, raising working-memory load
Rotation is bound to shape type (arrows always 180°), but half the options use the unseen 135° arrow rotation as a trap
Count progression is simple (+1 across each row) and shape/fill distributions are standard Latin-square patterns familiar from matrix tasks
Distractors differ from the key by exactly one attribute each, punishing partial rule discovery; 105 s is adequate for systematic checking
